summary: Import ResQ Reserving Classes now always offers its built-in list of default reserving classes and creates the folder for any listed class the project does not hold yet.
details: The review table lists the fixed default classes, all preselected, instead of scanning the project for every reserving-class folder; classes outside the list are never offered.
A listed class with no ArcRho folder yet shows as New in the table, is imported into a freshly created folder, and is named in the batch summary.
The macro no longer reads the shared support bundle to find its default selection, so the list is the same on every machine.
